analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 44.9 to 54.4, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from -0.1719 to 0.3168, signaling bottoming. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low ($508.66) and 20-day low ($508.66) being equal. ADX at 13.9 indicates a non-trending phase. Current price $525.83 is 4.15% above SMA200. Weekly RSI is 58.3 in neutral territory. Weekly ADX is 18.0, showing no trend. Overall, insufficient grounds for a buy signal, but the downtrend has paused. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
